subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the battle-worn male knight from Picture 1, with wet black hair, a glowing amber eye, layered dark steel armor, a torn crimson cape, and a broad lava-veined greatsword.
<Subject 2> is the silver-haired female duelist from Picture 2, with pale blue eyes, black-and-silver light armor, torn white-blue scarf panels, and two narrow ice-blue blades.

summary:
[reference generation] A 20-second cinematic high-speed duel uses <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> in a collapsing rain-soaked cathedral courtyard, beginning mid-attack and escalating through connected attacks, defenses, reversals, long-distance movement, airborne exchanges, destructive impacts, and a decisive finishing strike.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - his black hair, amber eye, dark damaged armor, crimson cape, and molten greatsword remain consistent.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - her silver hair, blue eyes, black-and-silver armor, pale torn scarf panels, and paired blades remain consistent.

detailed_description:
The target video is live-action cinematic fantasy with physically grounded stunt choreography, hard rain, cold moonlight, sparks, stone dust, and dense oppressive pacing. Every attack visibly drives the next defense, counter, displacement, and environmental consequence; there is no pause, pose-off, or repeated combination.

[Shot 1] A low medium-wide tracking shot opens already in motion: <Subject 1> is sprinting through ankle-deep rainwater across a shattered cathedral courtyard, completing a brutal horizontal greatsword cut toward <Subject 2>. <Subject 2> catches the descending blade between her crossed twin swords, but the force drives her boots backward, cutting twin trenches through wet stone. She turns her hips, slips one blade under his hilt to lever the greatsword upward, and uses the opening to slash toward his exposed ribs. <Subject 1> rotates with the forced lift, catches her blade on his armored forearm, then shoulder-checks her through a broken marble balustrade. The balustrade explodes outward; she converts the fall into a backward handspring over the rubble while he charges through the dust cloud.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a side-profile tracking shot, carrying over <Subject 1>'s charge as <Subject 2> lands on a tilted fallen column. She runs along its length, launches above his head, and stabs both blades downward. He raises the greatsword flat to block; the triple collision throws orange sparks and bends the blade edge downward. Using the locked weapons as a pivot, she swings around him in midair and kicks the back of his knee. His leg buckles, but he deliberately drops with the momentum, rolls beneath her landing arc, and sweeps the greatsword through the column's base. The column shears apart; the collapsing stone forces her to leap forward through falling debris. He follows in the same direction, dragging the sword tip across the ground and leaving a molten scar.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a fast overhead-to-low arc shot as <Subject 2> lands on the rim of a collapsed bell tower opening. <Subject 1> bursts from below through the broken wall, his upward sword strike blasting masonry into the air. She blocks one-handed, loses her left blade when the impact snaps its grip free, then catches the falling weapon in her opposite hand while twisting away from his second cut. She hurls the recovered blade into a stone pillar behind him; he knocks it aside with the greatsword, and the deflected blade severs a hanging iron chain. The enormous ruined bell drops between them. <Subject 2> slides beneath its descending edge; <Subject 1> drives his shoulder into the bell to redirect it, creating a swinging metal barrier that smashes through two pillars and clears a path toward the open rooftop.

[Shot 4] At 00:15.000, the camera becomes a large-amplitude fast tracking shot behind both fighters as they sprint up the freshly collapsed rubble ramp toward the rooftop edge. <Subject 2> uses the swinging bell chain as a whip, wrapping it around <Subject 1>'s sword arm and pulling him off-line; he counters by planting the greatsword into the roofstone, yanking the chain taut, and launching both fighters across the gap. In the airborne crossing, she thrusts her remaining blade at his throat; he clamps the blade between his gauntlet and sword guard, twists it free, and spins behind her before they land. He lands first in a knee-slide, using the stolen blade to pin her scarf to fractured stone for one instant, then releases it and completes the clear final action: a two-handed upward greatsword strike that stops a finger-width from her jaw while its shockwave splits the rooftop beneath her boots. Stone erupts around her; she drops to one knee, weaponless, as <Subject 1>'s crimson cape whips through rain and the glowing greatsword holds the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Relentless rain, boots skidding through water, strained breathing, armor impacts, sword-on-steel shrieks, and close-range grunts continue without silence. Each heavy collision produces distinct sparks, cracking stone, falling rubble, snapping chain links, and the deep metallic boom of the redirected bell.

non_diegetic_music:
Rapid low taiko drums and distorted cello ostinatos drive the tempo from the opening impact. Brass pulses and metallic percussion intensify through the airborne exchange, then cut sharply after the final shockwave.
